{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Exclude QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = (df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99)
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Exclude refunded orders
refunded_mask = (df_clean['status'] == 'refunded')
df_clean = df_clean[~refunded_mask].copy()

# Cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment to check for imbalance
print('Cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment:')
print(pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment']))

# Compute average revenue per order by channel and customer_segment
# Stratify by segment to avoid confounding
grouped = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'], as_index=False)['revenue_float'].mean()

# Compute overall average revenue per order per channel (unweighted across segments)
channel_avg = grouped.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_float'].mean()

# Extract values
total_email_avg = channel_avg[channel_avg['channel'] == 'email']['revenue_float'].iloc[0]
total_paid_search_avg = channel_avg[channel_avg['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue_float'].iloc[0]

# Compute difference
diff = total_paid_search_avg - total_email_avg

# Print results
print(f'Email channel average revenue: {total_email_avg:.4f}')
print(f'Paid search channel average revenue: {total_paid_search_avg:.4f}')
print(f'Difference (paid_search - email): {diff:.4f}')"}
